curriculum.objective: Find and name four familiar objects within one simple scene.
curriculum.instruction: Look carefully. Find and point to each object.
curriculum.evidence: Child finds, points to and names a kite, bench, tree and flower.
curriculum.teacher_facilitation: Name the first target, then let the child find the rest.
curriculum.parent_home_activity: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.
curriculum.parent_conversation: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.
curriculum.scene: One simple park scene in the upper 64 percent and exactly four isolated target assets in one equal bottom row: kite, bench, tree and flower.
curriculum.focal_point: A controlled observation scene with four exact find-it targets.

illustration_asset_prompt:
BCube Phase 2 Illustration Asset Prompt — CE-NURSERY-V4-P010

Create exactly one coordinated extraction sheet on a pure white background. The upper 64% contains one simple uncluttered park scene in which exactly one kite, one bench, one tree and one flower are visible and findable. The lower 32% contains exactly four isolated target assets in one equal left-to-right row: kite, bench, tree, flower. Keep a clear white gutter between the scene and target row and between every target. Each target appears exactly once in the target row. No teacher, children, Star mascot, words, labels, circles, cards, borders, page layout, duplicate targets or unrelated objects. Use premium Nursery publishing quality, large recognisable forms, thick rounded outlines, correct structure and generous safe margins.

rejection_gates: missing scene or any of the four target assets
more or fewer than four isolated targets
target order not kite, bench, tree, flower
target duplicated or contaminated by another row
generated text, logo, mascot, worksheet mechanics or decorative frame
